### User Story
As a **[Student / Landlord / Admin]**,  \
I want to **[action / functionality]**, \
So that **[business value / benefit]**. 

---

### Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin Syntax)
- [ ] **Scenario 1:** 
  - **Given** [initial context]
  - **When** [action taken]
  - **Then** [expected result]

- [ ] **Scenario 2:** 
  - **Given** [initial context]
  - **When** [action taken]
  - **Then** [expected result]
